decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details of a fume extraction ducting system shall be shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the A3 use.  The approved details shall be implemented prior to the commencement of the restaurant and retained thereafter.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 9am to 11.30 pm Monday to Saturday and 9am to 10pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
description: Change of use of premises to a flexible consent to allow A1 (retail), A2 (financial and professional services) or A3 (restaurant) use.
